source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.before: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,
key_decisions.after: Remind them to submit to rulers and authorities, to obey and to be ready for every good work,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves denial, mercy and paired washing/renewal means.
key_decisions.before: he saved us—not because of works we had done in righteousness, but according to his mercy—through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.after: he saved us—not because of righteous works we had done, but according to his mercy—through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: he saved us, not because of any works of righteousness that we had done, but according to his mercy, through the water[a] of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Spirit as poured gift and Christ's mediation.
key_decisions.before: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
key_decisions.after: whom he poured out richly on us through Jesus Christ our Savior,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains legal status, inheritance and hope.
key_decisions.before: so that, having been set right by his grace, we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
key_decisions.after: so that, justified by his grace, we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that being justified by his grace we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps two-stage correction and factional behavior.
key_decisions.before: After a first and second warning, have nothing more to do with a divisive person,
key_decisions.after: After a first and second warning, reject a divisive person,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: As for a person who stirs up division, after warning him once and then twice, have nothing more to do with him,
